faqs.question: Why should I use a dedicated landing page instead of my homepage?
faqs.answer: Homepages serve many different audiences and contain countless navigation links, social feeds, and diverse service offerings. When a user clicks a specific paid ad, they want immediate answers to that specific problem. Dedicated landing pages maintain 100% focus on that offer, removing all exit distractions and significantly improving conversion efficiency.

faqs.question: How does page speed affect my Google Ads costs?
faqs.answer: Google Ads factors landing page experience and load speed directly into your Quality Score. Faster landing pages earn higher Quality Scores, which directly lowers your cost-per-click (CPC) and earns higher ad positions for less money.

faqs.question: Can the landing page connect to our existing domain?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can deploy landing pages to custom subdirectories (such as yourdomain.co.uk/special-offer) or dedicated campaign subdomains (such as go.yourdomain.co.uk) without disrupting your main website.

faqs.question: Do you write the persuasive copy as well?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer commercial direct-response copywriting designed to grip attention, disarm objections, and compel decisive action.
